about: Modwerk source-only audio-in-routing package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/audio-in-routing.

mods.title: Audio In Routing
mods.summary: Two knobs on the FX track's DISTORTION page send the AUDIO IN jacks into the master distortion and compressor, and into the delay and the reverb.
mods.description: Two knobs on the FX track's DISTORTION page send the AUDIO IN jacks into the master distortion and compressor, and into the delay and the reverb.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: The author's builds AC20 and AC21 ran on an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 beside the RC12 and RC14 module sets, as reported; this package links to the same image as its source build AF22 but has not run on a unit.
